messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: ALERT: Elevated 5xx rate detected at API gateway (rule: gateway.5xx_rate > 3% over 5m). Affected regions: edge-us-west-1, edge-eu-1. Paging oncall: @olivia. Root TS: 1863001234

olivia: on it. jumping into logs now. can someone confirm customer impact?

maya: seeing multiple tickets for /v1/embed and /v1/chat/completions — users reporting 502/504s since ~00:50Z. ticket#3421,3423. severity: P1 for a few large customers.

sam: running quick check on ingress pods — tails from envoy show lots of `upstream connect error` and `504 upstream request timeout` to backend service `inference-router`. running command:
```
kubectl -n gateway logs deploy/gateway-proxy -c envoy --since=10m | egrep "(502|504|upstream)" | tail -n 80
```

sam: paste of last 10 lines:
```
[2026-03-14T00:51:12Z] "POST /v1/embed" 502 - "upstream connect error or disconnect"  "upstream_status: 502"
[2026-03-14T00:51:13Z] "POST /v1/chat/completions" 504 - "upstream request timeout"
[2026-03-14T00:51:14Z] "POST /v1/generate" 502 - "ECONNRESET from 10.2.5.12:443"
```

jen: any recent deploys to gateway or inference router?

deploy-bot: Deploy event: gateway-config v2026.03.14-04 rolled out to edge-us-west-1 at 00:34Z by sam. No rollbacks.

sam: yeah we pushed a small config change to Envoy timeouts + retry policy for embedding routes ~20m before spike. rolling that back as quick test.

olivia: do it and report. meanwhile enable temporary fallback routing to dedicated inference pool (dedicated-west) for high-value customers. maya, can you map tickets to customer IDs for manual routing?

maya: on it — sending mapping: acct-A, acct-B, acct-C. will add to incident thread.

sam: rollback in progress: `kubectl rollout undo deployment/gateway-config -n gateway --to-revision=2026.03.14-02`

sam: rollback applied in us-west. will monitor.

sam: immediately after rollback 5xx rate in us-west dropped from 6.7% to 1.1% over 3m. eu still elevated (2.8%).

jen: eu still at 2.8% — might be a separate symptom (connection pooling on inference-router in eu). sam, can you check upstream pod restarts /fd exhaustion?

sam: checking upstream pods in eu:
```
kubectl -n inference get pods -o wide --selector=app=inference-router
NAME
inference-router-0   Running (0 restarts)
inference-router-1   Running (5 restarts)
inference-router-2   Running (0 restarts)
```

sam: node eu-3 shows repeated OOM/killed events on inference-router-1 and high `TIME_WAIT` counts. looks like connection saturation.

olivia: mitigation plan: 1) route high-value customers to dedicated-west fallback (already started) 2) rollback gateway config (done) 3) temporarily increase upstream connection pool/keepalive for eu region and roll new config to inference-router eu 4) enable short circuiting/cap on retries at edge to avoid retry storms.

jen: I'll lead the inference-router config bump in eu. sam, can you add a traffic-shedding rule at edge to cap concurrent per-client to 8 for problematic routes?

sam: adding rate-limit rule now: `rate_limit: requests_per_unit: 8 per 1s` to /v1/generate and /v1/embed. patching edge config.

incident-bot: NOTE: rate limit change pushed to edge-eu-1 at 01:10Z. metric watchers updated.

sam: after rate limiting and routing changes eu 5xx dropped to 1.0% within 6m. no further restarts observed on inference-router-1.

maya: customer svc update: acct-A moved to dedicated-west, acct-B seeing improved responses. I'll keep support updates queued.

olivia: good. still tracking degraded SLO for ~20m window. creating incident timeline and will open postmortem. who wants to own next 2hr handoff?

sam: I can stay for immediate follow-up for 30m then hand off to jen for deeper infra changes.

jen: I will take the 2hr handoff and drive the inference-router fix + durable config rollout. will coordinate canary and ensure metrics stable.

olivia: tagging this as `incident/P1-gateway-5xx` and creating postmortem stub. olivia -> jen handoff at 01:30Z (see notes).

sam: for the postmortem I'll capture timeline and config diff (gateway-config v2026.03.14-04) + reason rollback fixed us-west. preliminary root cause: aggressive retry/timeout config in gateway causing connection churn to inference-router; combined with existing higher connection counts in eu led to overload and OOMs on a pod.

maya: support update sent to affected customers with ETA 2h and mitigation steps.

incident-bot: RESOLVED: 5xx rate back below threshold (0.7%) at 01:46Z. Incident will remain open for postmortem and RCA.

olivia: thanks everyone. jen — please own the RCA doc and include action items: revert risky retry changes to canary only, add stronger pre-deploy load tests for gateway config, add alert for upstream pod restarts and TIME_WAIT growth.

jen: will do. creating postmortem in #postmortems and will link here.

olivia: handing off to jen. I'm off-call. leave any follow-ups here. :white_check_mark:
